title: Law to set nutrition rules for chain kids' meals
summary: This bill would require children's menus at chain food service establishments with 15 or more locations to meet nutrition standards for calories, sodium, saturated fat and added sugar, and to offer at least two compliant meals. It also changes allowed beverage choices and serving sizes for children's meals and updates civil penalties for violations. The Department of Health and Mental Hygiene would be directed to issue rules on identifying and promoting compliant meals on menus.
